items.title: Stones verbally agrees Inter move amid Arsenal, Chelsea interest

items.title: O'Sullivan sets deadline to win record eighth snooker world title
items.summary: Ronnie O'Sullivan has set himself a deadline of winning a record-breaking eighth World Snooker Championship by 2028 and revealed he will retire from the sport if required to play qualifying matches.
